title: 8 ms Timing Separation Check
notes: Adds an 8 ms timing-separation check to the Shot Diagram Timing Sequence tool.
Flags every pair of eligible timed holes that is less than 8 ms apart; a difference of exactly 8 ms is accepted.
Shows the exact page, hole, timing values, and separation for each conflict.
Reports timed holes checked, eligible untimed holes, non-numeric timing values, and dirt or bad holes excluded.
Adds the check both to the active Timing Fill bar and to the Timing Sequence setup window.
Preserves the standardized cloud sync, JSON backup compatibility, Drill Log conversion, page renumbering, and existing timing-fill behavior.
